claims.claim: SHAZAM is member-owned and headquartered at 6700 Pioneer Parkway, Johnston, Iowa; no ownership change since 2020 is disclosed on the site.
claims.quote: member-owned financial services technology provider
claims.title: SHAZAM | Member-Owned Financial Services Technology Provider
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: HQ address 6700 Pioneer Parkway, Johnston, IA 50131 shown on homepage footer.

claims.claim: SHAZAM was founded in 1976 as the Iowa Transfer System and today employs about 650 people serving clients in 49 states plus DC under a member-owned nonprofit model.
claims.quote: Our 650 employees support clients across 49 states and Washington, D.C.
claims.title: Our Story | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page also states 'In 2025, we launched three new brands' (PEREGRINE, DigiHive, KinetiCore) and acquisitions: Cardinal Software 2010, FileX 2021 (now DocuCommand), Nicola Banking Systems 2022.

claims.claim: The SHAZAM network runs both single-message (Sure Pass) and dual-message (Elite Pass) pathways, i.e. it is a dual-capability debit network.
claims.quote: SHAZAM's pathway for single-message transactions, delivering real-time authorization and settlement for high-volume debit activity.
claims.title: SHAZAM Payments Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Elite Pass: 'Supports dual-message transactions, providing secure authorization and settlement for card-not-present and digital payment environments.' No card, ATM, transaction or participant counts are published on the page.

claims.claim: SHAZAM's endorsed-alliance list names about 24 state banking and credit union associations plus three grocery associations on the merchant side.
claims.quote: SHAZAM has partnered with trade organizations that champion community banks and credit unions at the state, regional and national levels.
claims.title: Strategic Alliances | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Includes Iowa Bankers Association, Iowa Credit Union League, IBAT, CBAO, Florida Bankers Association, Hawaii Credit Union League, PaymentsFirst; merchants: Iowa Grocery Industry Association, Midwest Retail & Grocery Alliance, Nebraska Grocery Industry Association.

claims.claim: PEREGRINE is SHAZAM's 2025-launched processing brand covering debit card, ATM and acquirer processing with direct connections to Visa and Mastercard.
claims.quote: powers debit card, ATM and acquirer processing, connecting financial institutions, fintechs and merchants directly to global card networks.
claims.title: PEREGRINE Processing Solutions | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also lists card controls, dispute resolution, real-time ATM monitoring and surcharge-free ATM access; tokenisation and digital wallets not mentioned on this page.

claims.claim: For fintechs SHAZAM offers the Peregrine gateway as a single connection to debit networks, requiring a sponsor financial institution, with open APIs.
claims.quote: single, secure connection to the debit networks
claims.title: Fintechs | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page references working 'with a sponsor financial institution', 'open APIs and flexible connectivity', 'Built for developers' and 'API-first infrastructure'; one testimonial from Qapital. CTA is a contact form only.

claims.claim: SHAZAMSecure is a value-added audit and cybersecurity catalogue (ACH, BSA/AML, IT and SAFE Act audits; penetration testing; managed firewall; phishing and vishing assessments).
claims.quote: External & Internal Penetration Testing – Simulates real‑world attacks to validate defenses
claims.title: SHAZAMSecure Security & Compliance | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor

claims.claim: KinetiCore core banking exposes a real-time open banking API framework and a Real-Time Interface for card management and authorization.
claims.quote: Our real‑time open banking API framework makes it easy to connect your core banking software to digital banking, card processing
claims.title: KinetiCore Core Banking | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Modules named: AccountLaunch, Core Insight, Check 21 Solution, LookOut, Real-Time Interface (RTI).

claims.claim: Merchants access SHAZAM through their existing processor rather than a direct merchant relationship; SHAZAM states all major U.S. merchant processors are connected.
claims.quote: All major merchant processors across the U.S. are already connected to the SHAZAM payments network
claims.title: Merchants | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also claims '$3B amount merchants save annually from routing to independent debit networks' and '26% average reduction in acceptance costs' (unsourced on page).

claims.claim: SHAZAM Payments Association is a Nacha Direct Member ACH association whose membership is limited to Iowa-based institutions in the seventh Federal Reserve district.
claims.quote: a proud Nacha® Direct Member and one of only nine Direct Member payments associations nationwide.
claims.title: SHAZAM Payments Association
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Members must complete an annual ACH audit; fees not published.

claims.claim: The Login menu on shazam.net names five gated client tools: SHAZAM Access, SHAZAM Files, ATM Monitor Plus, SHAZAM SystemChek and Business Intelligence Services.
claims.quote: To log into a SHAZAM application, click the appropriate link below:
claims.title: SHAZAM | Member-Owned Financial Services Technology Provider
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: URLs: SHAZAM Access https://portal.shazam.net/ShazamWebApps/mem_only.htm; SHAZAM Files https://portal.shazam.net/navigator/; ATM Monitor Plus https://portal.shazam.net/IMSClient; SystemChek https://portal.shazam.net/status; BIS https://bis.shazam.net/. portal.shazam.net/status and mem_only.htm both redirect to an IBM Tivoli Access Manager login ('Login Sign in Forgot / Change Password'), so the status page is not readable logged out.

claims.claim: There is no public developer portal: developer.shazam.net and developers.shazam.net do not resolve to SHAZAM content, and the site's API references route to a contact form.
claims.quote: open APIs and flexible connectivity
claims.title: Fintechs | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Absence finding: no API reference, sandbox, SDKs, OpenAPI, webhooks, versioning or rate limits are published anywhere on shazam.net that was read.

claims.claim: Membership is open to community banks and credit unions using SHAZAM services, on a one-member-one-vote basis with a member-elected board; joining is by contact form and no fees or timelines are published.
claims.quote: Every institution in our member-owned payments network receives financial institution voting rights, giving you a seat at the table
claims.title: Membership | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: 'Our one member, one vote model'; 'Profits are reinvested'; CTA /contact/lets-connect. No membership fee, application steps, certification programme or fintech fast-track published.

claims.claim: SHAZAM markets itself as having the industry's lowest issuer switch fee and a Durbin-compliant network, but publishes no interchange, switch or membership fee schedules.
claims.quote: The industry's lowest issuer switch fee
claims.title: SHAZAM Payments Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also 'Durbin-compliant debit network' with 'flexible domestic and global network pairings'. No figures given.

claims.claim: Training webinars are priced per attendee on a flat fee, with the recording included; the amount is not published.
claims.quote: One flat fee per attendee includes access to the session recording
claims.title: Training & Education | SHAZAM
claims.label: Vendor

claims.claim: The network rulebook is not public; the site describes integrated dispute and chargeback processes and Reg II routing compliance but links no rules document.
claims.quote: Integrated dispute and chargeback processes
claims.title: SHAZAM Payments Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Absence finding: no operating rules, bulletins, mandate calendar or edition/page count found on shazam.net; rules presumably live behind SHAZAM Access/SHAZAM Files.

claims.claim: Client Service is 24/7/365 on 800-537-5427, with Service Expert requests submitted through the gated SHAZAM Access portal; product lines (KinetiCore, Nicola, DocuCommand) have distinct phone menu paths.
claims.quote: submit a Service Expert request through SHAZAM Access (login required)
claims.title: Contact Us | SHAZAM
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Cardholder lines 800-383-8000 (lost/stolen) and 855-219-5399 (fraud); Nicola core email NBSDSSupport@shazam.net; ATM supplies via Systemax 800-525-9995. No SLAs published; languages not stated.

claims.claim: SHAZAM's client learning team offers live webinars, on-demand online courses inside SHAZAM Access, and custom training; a same-day resolution figure of over 95% of service calls is cited in press.
claims.quote: SHAZAM resolves more than 95% of service calls the same day.
claims.title: CBAO selects DigiHive digital banking for member banks
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Training page: 'Expert‑led webinars for practical, real‑world learning'; custom training at training@shazam.net. Events page showed 'No Results Found' at fetch time; event categories include 'SHAZAM Client Events' and 'SHAZAM Payments Association Members-only Webinars'.
